messages:
Priya: dropping a quick mock of the suppression scheduler + preview. need quick feedback on recurrence presets, timezone visibility, and preview copy. https://figma.com/file/suppress-scheduler :mag:
Liam: presets look good. prefer inline 'Mon-Fri 22:00-06:00' chips and an 'Advanced rules' link rather than a full custom editor up front.
Noah: backend gotcha: windows that cross midnight need clear wording and DST handling. Add a note 'local time (observes DST)'.
Elena: preview should expose 'Effective recipients' column — primary, escalation, webhooks. Right now it's ambiguous who'll actually get alerted.
Priya: suggested preview row: '#team-oncall — Suppressed (rule active) — Next: #backup-oncall' — concise and scannable.
Liam: mobile: convert preview table into stacked cards, show timezone at top of card.
Noah: QA checklist: 1) crossing-midnight rules, 2) DST transitions, 3) removed channels referenced by rules, 4) timezone override tests.
ux-bot: accessibility: ensure table headers are real headers, timezone selector modal avoids focus trap, and announce preview summary via aria-live when rules change.
Priya: will add a 'simulate' button that runs sample dates across a week and outputs who would receive notifications; also a collapsed sample webhook payload for integrators.
qa-bot: please include sample outputs for both suppressed and non-suppressed cases so integrators can validate receivers.
Priya: will update Figma with chips + simulate + DST hint and push to staging. scheduling a 20-min usability check tomorrow morning. :coffee:
